text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I invited Satono Diamond, who had been in a slump lately,
to go visit a shrine together, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Alright. I made sure to pray thoroughly for everyone's health and safety.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now that I've entrusted the family matters to them... all that's left is to head home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
? What is the matter?
You have such a puzzled look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, I deliberately chose
not to pray for anything personal."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I am not in good shape,
and it is not that I do not believe in God.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, if possible, I'd like to avoid relying solely on God or those around me to solve it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I really want to overcome this with my own strength.
...That's how I feel.
choice_data_list: Then, we can just ask for something else.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Something different... you say?
That would be—
choice_data_list: She says she wants you to watch over her as she overcomes it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Fufu, understood!
Then, allow me to pray once more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pat, pat)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Dear God...! I swear I will
overcome any hardship that comes my way...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...Together with those who support me!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Alright. This time our shrine visit is truly complete, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Knowing the gods are watching over us
makes me feel like putting even more of myself
into training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let myself wallow in a slump.
As soon as we get back, please give me some guidance right away!
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a bright and cheerful look on her face, Satono Diamond completely regained her top form after that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we head back now—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, the sky suddenly darkened—
and rain began pouring down out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be... a new hardship, just moments
after declaring we'd overcome any trial...!?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could it be they're testing me
to see if my resolve is true—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the Academy drenched by the rain,
Satono Diamond continued to struggle to get back into top form.
